limitations: FIA 2025 sporting map is the latest published control reference at acquisition; 2026 controls and team garage assignments need a later event update.
The promoter's August 2026 event map confirms grandstand categories; manually reconstructed North and T16 footprints and all stand heights are estimates, not survey data.
Sentinel true colour has native 10 m resolution. Fine ground boundaries come from OSM; authored material detail is not aerial photogrammetry.
GEDTM30 is a 30 m historical bare-earth estimate in EGM2008. Small berms, local banking and the 2023 earthworks are not surveyed.
No public LoD2/DSM was located. Building heights, facade rhythm, seat row patterns and floodlight dimensions are source-informed estimates.
Permanent team hospitality pavilions are modelled from current mapped footprints. Unconfirmed 2026 motorhomes, transporters and small temporary tents are omitted.
